name: Profit Cultural and Creative Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Profit Cultural and Creative Group Co., Ltd., established in 1995 and headquartered in Fuzhou, China, operates globally, specializing in the development, design, marketing, and distribution of household goods. Their extensive product range encompasses footwear for all demographics—men, women, children, and toddlers—alongside a variety of bags, such as everyday packs, outdoor gear, business cases, and children's specific designs. The company also offers timepieces and a wide array of home decor items, including furniture, wall art, storage solutions, tableware, cushions, motion-sensing waste bins, and decorative metal wall pieces.
